articles.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
articles.snippet: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.snippet: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

articles.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
articles.snippet: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

articles.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
articles.snippet: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

articles.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
articles.snippet: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.
